title: Expose plan guidance as a preview plugin skill
summary: BCQuality now exposes plan guidance as a preview plugin skill alongside code review, allowing users to call either capability through Entry as the shared router that handles index preparation and action selection.
key_points: Added new preview host skill for plan guidance that enriches plans without routing or rewriting
Restructured documentation to present BCQuality as capabilities instead of individual skills
Entry router now handles index preparation, layer and skill settings, and action selection for both code review and plan guidance
CI workflows can still call Entry directly for integrations
Plan guidance returns read-only development guidance report with no changes to routing or schemas
